item.title: Report exposes cyber-attack risk to Galway City Council
item.description: A ‘top secret’ report contains information that could expose Galway City Council to cyber-attacks, with potential to majorly disrupt frontline services. The 42-pages Cyber Security Audit commissioned by City Hall last September identified weaknesses in the local authority’s cyber defences. item.title: Council presses Coillte on dangerous roadside trees
item.description: By Avril Horan CALLS have been made for Coillte to carry out a full investigation into dangerous roadside trees across the county.
